title: Three lifts a day, a bit more each time
description: Two short barbell days taken in turns. Squat every session, alternate the presses and pulls, and add a small plate whenever all the sets went well.
about:
This is the shape most first strength programmes share: three sessions a week, squats every time, and progress measured in kilos rather than in how tired you feel.

Start lighter than your ego wants. Add 2.5 kg to the squat and deadlift, and 1 to 2.5 kg to the presses, every session you finish all the reps. When a lift stalls three times in a row, take ten percent off and build back up.

exercises.note: One heavy set after warm-ups. That is the whole point.
